text:
Marta: Quick sanity check before dark-launch: we want active/active but must honor residency for regulated tenants without SDK changes. Decision by EOD.
Aj: Edge-only approach: X-RW-Residency header + short-lived signed assertion from control-plane. Edge caches assertion and injects X-Res-Verified when forwarding.
sre-simon: Good. Add metrics: residency_assertion_miss, residency_misroute_count, residency_cache_local_miss. Also circuit-breaker to avoid oscillation.
Chen: KV concern: routing EU->EU while KV is NA will hurt p95. Proposal: hot-prefix replication to EU + cross-region read-forward for cold keys. I'll simulate numbers.
legal-elaine: Compliance: we need immutable residency_decision logs (tenant, ts, edge, decision, fallback) retained 90 days. Include fallback reason.
deploy-bot: Canary launched: residency-edge-v1 -> 3% traffic. Canary id canary-4876. Pause on >0.5% error delta or +60ms p95.
Marta: Action items: Aj -> spec + edge pseudo-code; Chen -> cache/replication playbook + sim; SRE-simon -> dashboards + alerts; Legal -> retention spec. Ramp plan: 3% -> 20% -> 50% if canary stable.
